quote_consistency.interpretation: Ticker fields are returned together but do not expose exchange event timestamps or sequence IDs; do not treat last trade and quotes as a synchronized order-book event.

spot_market.depth_status: Top-of-book only from Kraken; multi-venue depth is recorded separately with its own snapshot time and venue coverage.

limitations: Seven-exchange OI universe; liquidation and account-ratio sample covers five exchanges.
Liquidation figures are lower bounds because venues disclose only part of liquidations.
Long/short ratio is an account-count measure, not notional exposure.
Mark price and Kraken spot ticker are not synchronized or interchangeable.
Hourly snapshot is 7 hours older than the Kraken retrieval upper bound.
Binance and Bitget are absent; four venues provide full depth while two add near-price depth only.
Resting orders can be cancelled; depth is not executable slippage or guaranteed support.

edgeornot.market_scope: Binance spot and OKX perpetual combined
limitations: Mixed spot/perpetual scope; not a pure spot-book comparison.
Snapshot is historical and orders can be placed or pulled quickly.

comparability.reason: Different venue coverage, instrument scope, price snapshot and retrieval time; do not average or infer a continuous depth change.

selected_exchange_rows.notes: Includes 150.7M XRP backing cbXRP on Base; cold storage >99% of labeled hot/cold split.
Includes Binance-Peg XRP reserve on BNB Chain and Binance US balance; not all customer tradable balance.

wrapped_and_noncustomer_reserve_reconcil.note: The same page table lists 327.4M Binance-Peg reserve while its methodology text lists 325.8M; both are preserved. The 487.7M total reconciles to the methodology figure, not the table figure.

exchange_balances.methodology: Balances are read from XRPL account_info; attribution uses XRPSCAN public labels. Same-wallet changes remove newly tracked wallets and compare the same wallet set. The source states that wallet balances include cold storage, omnibus custody, wrapped-token reserves and non-customer balances; this is not tradable float.
limitations: Tracked exchange-wallet total is a labeled-wallet floor, not an official exchange-reserve total.
Same-wallet changes can still reflect transfers to wallets not yet labeled/tracked, not customer withdrawals or sales.
The source's Binance wrapped-reserve table and methodology figures differ by 1.6M XRP; unresolved.
Tracked large transfers only, not a complete ledger flow census.
Internal and exchange-to-exchange transfers are excluded.
USD values are recorded estimates; transfers are not proof of sales or purchases.
The rounded inflow and outflow totals differ by 20.01M XRP, while the page reports -20.02M XRP; preserve the publisher's rounded net without forcing exact equality.

lending_design_boundary.lending_protocol_design: XLS-66 describes fixed-term loans with off-chain underwriting and uncollateralized borrower loans.
lending_design_boundary.vault_deposits: XLS-65 deposits are funding capital into a single-asset vault; not evidence of borrower collateral posted.
lending_design_boundary.activation_status: LendingProtocol and SingleAssetVault remain below the 29/35 vote threshold; zero amendments are in the 14-day activation countdown.
lending_design_boundary.live_use_evidence: No live loan, vault capital, XRP collateral or lending settlement volume is established.

limitations: Own-node validator roll call and third-party publisher snapshot; counts are time-specific.
Do not infer activation from a majority below threshold or from fixCleanup3_4_0 activation.
No amendment has an active 14-day countdown in the observed snapshot.

market_context.binance_incident_reference: Earlier #1643 research artifacts record the Oct 29 2026 Binance breach, XRP wallet drain and attribution caveats. Reuters' Nov 2 platform-wide outflows are not XRP-specific and must not be used as an XRP flow feature.
market_context.note: The incident is a possible exchange-confidence and wallet-flow confounder, not evidence that stolen XRP was sold.

disconfirming: Liquidations are lower bounds and account ratios are not notional exposure.

disconfirming: Supply is not payment volume, transfer velocity, issuer cash redemption or XRP demand.

supporting: October payrolls surprised at +165K with wages +0.4% m/m; the macro release can change rate expectations.
The prior Binance breach and platform-wide withdrawals may affect exchange confidence and market risk appetite.
disconfirming: The jobs report also shows labor-market resilience; equities rebounded after the release in secondary market reporting.
No synchronized event study isolates macro or Binance-incident effects on XRP.

supporting: SingleAssetVault and LendingProtocol amendments are in-flight and could add a native lending stack if activated.
disconfirming: Votes are 23/35 and 21/35 versus 29/35 required; zero activation countdowns.
XLS-66 design is uncollateralized and off-chain underwritten; vault deposits are funding capital, not borrower collateral.
No live lending volume or XRP collateral is established.

forecast_status.reason: No directional forecast is authorized: source cutoffs are asynchronous, exchange-flow and ETF universes disagree, and the synchronized point-in-time historical dataset and evaluator-attested out-of-sample lift remain insufficient.

model_eligibility.reason: Rendered-source excerpt receipts are not original HTTP wire receipts; no common point-in-time cutoff; Kraken provider event timestamp absent; order-book snapshots have different times and venue scopes; exchange balances include cold/non-customer reserves; ETF flow universes differ; stablecoin supply is not payments data; no leakage-safe cross-domain event study or evaluator attestation.

limitations: No exact provider event timestamp or sequence ID for the Kraken ticker response.
No byte-complete HTTP body/header capture or independent timestamp anchoring in this research artifact.
Order-book snapshots are time- and venue-specific; Fuelmaps omits Binance and Bitget.
Exchange-wallet balances include cold storage, wrapped-token reserves, omnibus custody and wallet-label coverage gaps.
The XRP Insights source has an internal 1.6M XRP Binance-Peg reserve discrepancy between its table and methodology text.
TrackWhale reports tracked large transfers, not complete exchange flows or actual trades.
ETF holdings deltas are not direct AP cash creations/redemptions and publisher universes differ.
DefiLlama stablecoin market cap is not payment throughput or XRP demand.
No directional forecast, paper trade or real-money action was performed.
